headline: CISA adds Check Point PHP2Shell and UnrealIRCd flaws to KEV, due 11-16; N-central zero-day hits patched servers

bullets.text: New: CISA added Check Point CVE-2026-123039 (PHP2Shell) and UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 to KEV on 11-13, with a federal due date of 11-16. Attackers use the Check Point flaw to gain root, plant a TSGA backdoor and wipe VMware ESXi. No fixed release version is on the board.

Also new: a China-nexus actor is using an AI tool against US defense and semiconductor firms; Mior and Skyfall attacks let rogue cloud hosts steal secrets from AMD SEV-SNP VMs. A cyberattack disrupted German military drone operations.

N-central (PoC, 5 outlets): the N-able zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe. MSPs (8 outlets): worm-like SCKit spreads through ScreenConnect support sessions.

Law enforcement disrupted Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC infrastructure; DOJ ties Gootloader to 44+ ransomware attacks costing $29M. FBI says North Korean hackers stole $400M+ in crypto via deepfake video calls. SilentAir intercepts SMS 2FA codes inside Asian mobile networks.

Breaches: Uber (drivers' license data), TSMC (employees, via a cloud provider), 144,000+ Norwegian and Widerøe passengers, Apify customers, UT Arlington. Ransomware disrupted cloud firm ActiveCloud for days; Trezor confirms implants in CryptoBilis-sold wallets.

Still active: Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618, SignDrop Windows SYSTEM zero-day, Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. KEV due 11-24: BroadWorks, Openwave CVE-2026-111793, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. Last 7 days run 1.24x the 90-day average.

actions: Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039 before 11-16, restrict gateway management access, hunt for TSGA backdoors and keep ESXi backups offline.
UnrealIRCd: patch or take internet-facing servers offline for CVE-2026-114713 before the 11-16 KEV due date.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions.
Check endpoints for Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC; prefer app or hardware-key MFA over SMS and warn finance staff about deepfake video calls.
Patch Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618 and queue BroadWorks, Openwave, Outlook and Chromium before 11-24.
